ayahOccurrences.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُشْرِكُونَ نَجَسٌ فَلَا يَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ بَعْدَ عَامِهِمْ هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ عَيْلَةً فَسَوْفَ يُغْنِيكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ إِن شَآءَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُشْرِكُونَ نَجَسٌ فَلَا يَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ بَعْدَ عَامِهِمْ هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ عَيْلَةً فَسَوْفَ يُغْنِيكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ إِن شَآءَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: عَيْلَةً is in the derivative form: عَيْلَةٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ع/ي/ل ʿ–y–l children, family, to have many children
; to be underfed, to be dependent, to be poor; to deviate; to be conceited, to walk with a conceited gait. There is a certain degree of overlapping between this root and the root ع/و/ل ʿ–w–l (q.v.), whereby the sense of ‘to have many children’ might be derived from either.

Of this root, 2 forms, maybe three, occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
عَائِلاً ʿāʾilan; عَيْلَةٌ ʿaylatan (and, possibly, تَعُولُوا taʿūlū).
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
عَيْلَةٌ ʿaylatun [v. n./n.] being in straitened conditions, poverty, want

(9:28) ‏وَإِنْ‏ ‏خِفْتُمْ‏ ‏عَيْلَةً‏ ‏فَسَوْفَ‏ ‏يُغْنِيكُمُ‏ ‏اللَّهُ‏ ‏مِنْ‏ ‏فَضْلِهِ‏ ‏إِنْ‏ ‏شَاءَ‏ and if you fear want, God will enrich you of His bounty, if He wishes.

entries.label: تَعُولُ
entries.definitionHtml: تَعُولُ taʿūl [imperf. of v. intrans. عالَ ʿāla] to have too many children (in an interpretation of 4:3) ‏ذَلِكَ‏ ‏أَدْنَى‏ ‏أَلاَّ‏ ‏تَعُولُوا that is nearer (i.e., more likely) [cause] for your not having [too] many children (see ع/و/ل ʿ–w–l).

entries.label: عَائِلٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
عَائِلٌ ʿāʾil [act. part.] one who is in straitened circumstances, one who is needy, impoverished

(93:8) وَوَجَدَكَ‏ ‏عَائِلا‏ ‏فَأَغْنَى‏ and did He not find you in need and make you self‐sufficient?
